decls.name: IdealCountByNormBound

paper_span.quote: combined with the elementary divisor-function bound for the number of ideals of a given norm

decls.rationale: The divisor-function count completing Proposition 3.7: the number of ideals of norm \(m\) is at most \(d_n(m)\), and \(\sum_{m \le X} d_n(m) \le C^n X(1+\log X)^{n-1}/(n-1)!\), exponential in \(n\) when \(\log X = O_A(n)\).
